title: Set 172

sentences.ko: 작동은 잘 되는데, 소리를 끝까지 올리면 왼쪽 스피커가 좀 지직거려서 20달러 깎았어요. 나중에 그걸로 메시지 받는 것보다 지금 말씀드리는 게 나을 것 같아서요.
sentences.text: It works fine, it's just that the left speaker crackles a bit if you turn it all the way up, so I knocked twenty bucks off. I'd rather tell you now than have you message me about it later.

alts.text: Works fine, the left speaker just crackles a little when you crank it all the way up, so I took twenty bucks off. Figured I'd tell you now instead of you messaging me about it later.

It works perfectly well. The only issue is that the left speaker crackles slightly at full volume, so I have reduced the price by twenty dollars. I would rather mention it now than have you contact me about it later.

sentences.note: **knocked twenty bucks off** 는 값에서 20달러를 깎았다는 뜻입니다. **I'd rather tell you now than** ~ 는 ~하느니 차라리 지금 말하겠다는 뜻이고, casual 의 **crank it all the way up** 은 볼륨을 끝까지 올린다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 자, 우리 30분째 화면만 넘기고 있어. 하나만 더 싫다고 하면 내가 고를 거고, 그땐 불평하기 없기야.
sentences.text: Okay, we've been scrolling for half an hour. If you say no to one more thing, I'm picking, and you don't get to complain about it.

alts.text: Half an hour of scrolling, seriously. One more no and I'm picking, and you can't complain.
We have been scrolling for half an hour now. If you decline one more option, I will make the choice, and you will not be able to complain about it.

sentences.note: **you don't get to complain** 은 너는 불평할 자격이 없다, 불평하기 없기라는 뜻입니다. **scrolling** 은 화면을 계속 넘기며 고르는 것을 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 윗집에 꼬마가 있는데 아침 6시부터 이리저리 뛰어다녀. 애니까 이해는 하는데, 한 달째 6시 넘어서까지 자 본 적이 없어서 좀 미칠 것 같아.
sentences.text: The people upstairs have a little kid who runs back and forth from six in the morning, and I get it, he's a kid, but I haven't slept past six in a month and I'm kind of losing my mind.

alts.text: Upstairs neighbors' little kid runs back and forth starting at six a.m. I get it, he's a kid, but I haven't slept past six in a month and I'm kinda going crazy.
The family upstairs has a young child who runs back and forth from six in the morning. I understand that he is only a child, but I have not slept past six in a month, and I am close to my wits' end.

sentences.note: **I get it** 은 이해한다, 알겠다는 뜻의 구어입니다. **losing my mind** 는 미칠 것 같다는 뜻이고, **slept past six** 는 6시를 넘겨서까지 잤다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 주말 내내 아무것도 안 했거든. 죄책감 들 줄 알았는데, 솔직히 이렇게 월요일부터 벌써 피곤하지 않은 건 진짜 오랜만이야.
sentences.text: I didn't do a single thing all weekend, and I thought I'd feel guilty about it, but honestly, this is the first Monday in ages where I'm not already tired.

alts.text: Did absolutely nothing all weekend. Thought I'd feel guilty, but honestly? First Monday in forever I'm not wiped out already.
I did not do anything at all over the weekend, and I expected to feel guilty about it. To be honest, however, this is the first Monday in a long time on which I do not already feel tired.

sentences.note: **the first Monday in ages** 는 그런 월요일이 정말 오랜만이라는 뜻으로, **in ages** 는 아주 오랫동안이라는 말입니다. casual 의 **wiped out** 은 완전히 지쳤다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 퇴근하고 헬스장 가려고 했는데 운동화를 집에 두고 와서, 가지러 집에 갔다가 소파에 잠깐 앉았는데 거기서 끝났지 뭐.
sentences.text: I was going to go to the gym after work, but I'd left my sneakers at home, so I went home to get them, sat down on the couch for a second, and that was the end of that.

alts.text: Was gonna hit the gym after work, but I'd forgotten my sneakers at home. Went back to grab them, sat on the couch for a sec, and yeah, that was it.
I had intended to go to the gym after work, but I had left my athletic shoes at home. I went home to retrieve them, sat down on the couch for a moment, and that was the end of it.

sentences.note: **that was the end of that** 은 그걸로 끝이었다, 계획이 그대로 무산됐다는 뜻입니다. casual 의 **hit the gym** 은 헬스장에 가다라는 구어입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

reviewed: 3번 formal 의 it is becoming rather difficult for me 는 losing my mind 를 너무 눅여서 뜻이 약해졌습니다. 말투만 올리고 강도는 살리도록 I am close to my wits' end 로 고쳤습니다.
4번 note 가 the first Monday in ages 를 정말 오랜만의 월요일이라고 풀어서 뜻이 어긋났습니다. 오랜만에 처음으로 그런 월요일이라는 뜻으로 고쳤습니다.
